name: [TEST] Dirty Money: A PAYDAY® Experience
desc:
**NEW CODE AT 20K LIKES**

Use code 5KSNIPER for an in-game reward!

Mask up and step into the ultimate Looter‑Shooter Heist Experience.
Break into vaults, lockpick safes, steal high‑value loot, and fight your way out in fast‑paced co‑op action. 

This is an open testing build, so expect constant updates, new heists, and fresh content as we shape the game with your feedback.

Upgrade your gear, master each location, and pull off riskier, more rewarding heists.

Play solo or form a crew of up to 4 players across all platforms.
Your loot. Your crew. Your escape.

scripts.title: Larpium FREE
scripts.features:
- Combat
   - Silent Aim: Redirects shots to target limb (Head/Torso/etc). Includes FOV radius, adjustable Hit Chance, target NPCs, and target safezone players.   
   - Anti-Aim: Constant erratic spinning to avoid enemy fire.

   - Automation & Farming
   - Auto Kill: Select target, track, kill, and auto-loot (optionally).
   - Auto Sweeper: Completes the Street Sweeper quest automatically. (the kill 3 players one)
   - Auto Kill & Loot: Kills every player, loots their bags, and auto-deposits in your Stash.
   - Auto Assassination Quest: Accepts contracts, tracks targets, kills, and repeats the process.
   - Auto Red Safe: Detect, teleport, opens, and loot Red Safe when it spawns.
   - Auto Loot: Automatically collects items from unlocked containers.
   - Xp + Cash farm: Gives you a lot of cash and XP every fraction of a second.
   - Auto Smuggler: Automates Courier quest (the delivering packages one)

   - Character Utilities
   - Inf Stamina: Unlimited running/stamina.
   - Auto Heal: Detects injuries; auto-uses Bandages/Medkits.
   - Auto Revive: Moves you to safehouse so you revive when knocked, then takes you back to where you got knocked.
   - No Fall: Disables fall damage.
   - Instant Interaction: No-hold interaction for all prompts.

   - World & Bypasses
   - Auto Lockpick: Instantly bypasses lockpick mini-game.
   - Auto Bypass Safe: Instantly bypasses safe-cracking mini-game.
   - Anti-Hazards: Removes/disables Gas, Cameras, Lasers, and Vault Door restrictions in Heists. (each is a separate feature)

   - UI & Visuals
   - Keybinds: Overlay showing active functions and keybindings.
   - Staff List: Live tracker to monitor game staff present in server.
   - ESP: Tracks all players and NPCs and shows you their location and informations.
